risks.note: The Indian BOPP industry is passing through a significant capacity-addition cycle; if supply growth exceeds consumption growth for sustained periods, selling spreads and utilisation levels across the industry may come under pressure, intensified by aggressive pricing from new entrants or existing producers filling new lines.

Polypropylene prices are linked to crude oil, naphtha/propylene economics, refinery and petrochemical operating rates, import parity, currency movements and regional supply disruptions; film selling prices do not always adjust with the same timing, which can create inventory gains/losses and compress spreads.

Exports are an important outlet for surplus domestic production but are exposed to international competition, trade barriers, anti-dumping or safeguard actions, freight differentials and currency volatility; weakness in overseas markets increases pressure on the domestic market.
Geopolitical disruptions in West Asia or major shipping routes can increase import and export logistics costs and disturb raw-material availability.
In commodity and standard BOPP film grades, product differentiation is limited and price competition can be intense, particularly as new and expanded film lines increase competitive intensity.

Environmental regulation and EPR requirements are progressively influencing packaging design and recycling obligations; failure to adapt product portfolios to changing regulatory and brand-owner requirements could affect competitiveness.
risks.risk: Regulatory and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) requirements

risks.note: Management flags customer concentration, credit risk, equipment downtime, quality claims, cyber security, availability of skilled manpower and interest-rate movements as normal business risks.

Execution risk is associated with major capital projects; the commercial success of the Company's expansion will depend on timely commissioning, efficient ramp-up, cost competitiveness and the ability to place incremental volumes without compromising return thresholds.
